title: Typecheck executor schema
description: Runs TypeScript type checking without emitting files, over the library config and the spec config.

tsConfig.description: Path to the library TypeScript configuration file, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to {projectRoot}/tsconfig.lib.json.

specTsConfig.description: Path to the spec TypeScript configuration file, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to {projectRoot}/tsconfig.spec.json, checked when that file exists.
